data.one_liner: Provides an API and CLI to format Dart source code automatically.
data.what_it_does: Rewrites Dart code to follow the official Dart style guide, handling indentation, line wrapping, and punctuation. It can be used as a library or via the `dart format` command.
use_when: Enforcing consistent code style in a project
Running formatting in CI or pre‑commit hooks
avoid_when: When you require linting beyond formatting
strengths: Official package from the Dart team
Works with the Dart SDK `dart format` command
weaknesses: Only formats code, no linting or analysis
